To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the multi-armed bandt paradigm is an effective tool for designing online experiments, (ii) there are many variants to the multi-armed model, each of which is appropriate for certain classes of experiments, (iii) the stochastic multi-armed bandi model is a reasonable approximation for a large class of online experiments, (iv) there is a large body of research on this model and the variants, and (v) the research is still ongoing and there are many open questions and

the stochastic bandit model is a good approximation for many experiment design problems and that the existing theoretical work is a useful tool for the practitioner.
